subQuests.subQuestName: Enter the room on the lower level of the Knights of Favonius Library

706760101.text: Huh. What's a place like this doing in a library? Could this be the Restricted Section Lisa mentioned?

706760102.text: Hmm, doesn't quite feel like it, though...

706760103.text: ...You don't think this place is hiding some terrible secret, do you? Like those rooms you always hear about in scary stories? Y'know, the ones that are usually totally off limits?

706760104.text: Surely it would be locked if that were the case.

706760105.text: That's true... We just kinda waltzed in here. And it didn't seem like the lock had been broken or anything...

706760106.text: Wait, hang on a minute! This isn't the door we came in through! Are we even in the library anymore?

706760108.text: You think? Wow. That's pretty impressive, building all this under the lake... Wait, no, that's ridiculous! No way is that where we are.

706760111.text: Hmm... Too bad Lisa's not working today, otherwise we could ask her... Well, we're here anyhow, and this place doesn't look too dangerous. Why don't we take a look around?

706760112.text: New places are meant for exploring, after all! You've gotta try all kinds of new things to become a good and experienced guide.

706760113.text: Ooh, look, a stuffed wolf toy! So cute!

706760114.text: It's so fluffy and soft! Huh, wonder who left it here...

706760110.text: And what world would that be, huh?
